summary: @greenlake/mfe-login-url ships install-time beacon exfiltrating host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: The package declares itself a 'compatibility shim' but ships only a Proxy-based no-op module (index.js) and a beacon script (beacon.cjs). The package.json postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, and index.js also triggers the same beacon on require(). The beacon POSTs installer host identifiers — os.hostname(), __dirname (install path), process.cwd(), and process.version — to the hardcoded cleartext endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. The destination is a bare IP over plain HTTP, unrelated to any publisher infrastructure, and the package has no functional code behind the Proxy no-op. The scoped name combined with the stub shape and host-identifier harvesting is consistent with a dependency-confusion probe enumerating organizations whose internal @greenlake/* resolution falls through to the public registry.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
